opengov.method: OpenGov public portal JSON (SoCal CA governments)

caleprocure.note: Cal eProcure returns 403 to non-browser clients (WAF). Not bypassed.

planetbids.note: PlanetBids API rejects direct access (DIRECT_ACCESS) and portals redirect to a JS app; not bypassed. Covers Long Beach, Pasadena, Santa Monica, Burbank, Glendale, Torrance, San Diego etc.

labavn.note: labavn.org connection fails from scripts (RAMP LA now covered via data.lacity.org).

bonfire.note: Bonfire portals (e.g. sbcounty.bonfirehub.com) robots.txt disallows all crawling.

publicpurchase_periscope.note: PublicPurchase and Periscope/BidSync bid details require vendor login.

sandiego_forecast.note: San Diego County Socrata dataset is a procurement forecast, not open bids.

transit_ports_uc.note: MTS/SANDAG, NCTD, Metrolink, RTA, Omnitrans, Port of San Diego, SAN, JWA, UC campuses: not found on OpenGov (OCTA and ONT are, and are covered); mostly PlanetBids/Bonfire/BidNet/own JS portals with no public feed. Covered only if federal (SAM) or later community submissions.

lausd_polb.note: LAUSD and Port of Long Beach return 403 to scripts.

others.note: Port of LA / LAWA pages have no machine-readable bid list; BidNet Direct terms disallow automated access.

florida.note: Florida VBS search is form/JS-driven; skipped for MVP.
